sample.description: Headline technologies; ES and EO joined on Country x tech x supply_chain; pairs flagged constant or unscored in either pillar's index_cells diagnostics dropped, as are pairs one pillar does not score; only cells rankable in both pillars (sovereign, imputed weight share <= 0.5). Percentile ranks, medians and Spearman correlations are computed within pair over the rankable cells. Quadrants use strictly-above-median within pair (ties count as low).

covariance_decomposition.description: Within-pair covariance of ES and EO levels split as Cov(A_ES,A_EO) + Cov(A_ES,B_EO) + Cov(B_ES,A_EO) + Cov(B_ES,B_EO) (eq:joint_cov), A = summed contributions of shared components, B = the rest. Pooled shares weight each pair's covariances by n - 1.

within_country.description: Over each country's Strategic Index cells (pillar levels): Pearson and Spearman correlation of EO and ES (that of EO and 1 - ES is its negative), SD of Delta = EO - ES, and 2 Cov(EO,ES) / (Var EO + Var ES), the share of the variance sum removed from Var(Delta).

nonshared.rule: A component is shared when, in the same category, the other pillar has a component whose observed (non-imputed) values are identical (|diff| < 1e-9) in >= 99% of >= 30 jointly observed cells. Non-shared pillars are the weighted means of the remaining components with effective weights renormalised; undefined where every component of a pillar is shared.

category_correlations.method: Spearman correlation across countries within each technology-stage pair in which both categories are present and vary (>= 20 countries), averaged with equal weights across pairs.

scatter_median_line.description: joint_scatter draws the region boundaries at percentile rank 0.5; cells tied at a median count as low but are plotted at the mean rank of their tie group. Cells plotted on the other side of a line from the region they are counted in.
